events.text: At the spring banquet the old food taster sets down his chopsticks very slowly, and does not pick them up again. Across the hall the Chief Eunuch keeps smiling. The eunuchs of the Inner Court have not forgiven you for the year you cut their purse in half.

choices.text: Seal the palace and have the kitchens questioned tonight
Send the Chief Eunuch a gift, and their purse back
Say nothing, and finish the banquet

events.text: For a month you have slept badly and woken with a heavy head. Tonight a junior eunuch, shaking, kneels at the door of your study and whispers that the incense in your bedchamber is not the incense the records say it is.

choices.text: Have the incense traced to whoever ordered it
Summon the Chief Eunuch and come to terms
Send the frightened eunuch away; you are only tired

events.text: A flood of memorials reaches your desk in one week, all in the finest calligraphy, all saying the same thing: that your most loyal officers are thieves. The Grand Secretaries of the Pure Stream sign every one. Half of what they say is invented, and the other half is very well chosen.

choices.text: Have the memorials checked word by word against the ledgers
Give the Pure Stream the posts they want, and the memorials stop
Believe them, and let the accused fall

events.text: The censors come to the dawn audience in a body and read out a memorial: the comet last winter was Heaven's displeasure with your rule, and the records of the Astronomical Bureau prove it. You have read those records. They say nothing of the kind.

choices.text: Bring the astronomers and the true records to the hall
Issue an edict of self-reproach and promote the censors
Let the memorial stand; arguing with omens never helps

events.text: At the third watch a captain of the palace guard is brought to you in chains of his own asking. The generals, he says, have bought the Meridian Gate. In three nights the gate will be open, and the army that comes through it will not be coming to bow.

choices.text: Change every guard on every gate before dawn
Call the generals in and give them the war and the silver they want
Send the captain back to his post; the army is loyal

events.text: The garrison outside the capital has been drilling at night, and the drills face the city. When you ask why, the Generals' answer is polite, short, and signed by none of them.

choices.text: Move a loyal regiment into the city and arrest the ringleaders
Ride out to the camp yourself, with gifts and promotions
Do nothing; soldiers drill, that is what they do

events.text: The Empress Dowager receives you in the plum garden, pours your tea with her own hands, and remarks that the succession is too important to be left to the throne alone. Her brothers and nephews sit very still around the pavilion. They have chosen an heir for you already.

choices.text: Thank her, and have her brothers sent to govern far provinces
Give her clan the salt offices, so the heir stays your choice
Let the Empress Dowager have her way; she usually does

events.text: A letter in the Empress Dowager's hand is found in the Ministry of Rites: if the throne should fall ill, it says, her clan will guard the realm until the heir comes of age. You are not ill. You read the letter twice anyway.

choices.text: Lay the letter before the whole court
Visit her palace with the letter, and leave with an agreement
Burn the letter and say nothing

events.text: Consort {ct_consort} kneels before you in the hall of the Inner Palace, the eldest child of their house at their side, and asks one thing: that the child be named heir. Every other consort of the palace has heard about this audience before it began.

choices.text: Name the child heir before the ancestral tablets
Refuse, and tell {ct_consort} not to ask again
Say you will think on it, and find out who put them up to it

events.text: A cursed charm wrapped in red thread is found under the floor of one consort's pavilion, and every finger in the Inner Palace points at {ct_consort}. Two great houses are already writing to their kin at court.

choices.text: Have the matter looked into quietly before anyone is punished
Rebuke {ct_consort} in front of the whole palace
Send gifts to every pavilion and declare the matter closed

events.text: At the New Year audience Consort {ct_consort} takes the seat nearest the throne, the seat that belongs to the first of the household. Nobody says anything. Everybody looks at you.

choices.text: Let it stand, and let the child of that house be the heir
Have {ct_consort} moved back to their own seat
Smooth it over with gifts for every pavilion
Ask afterwards, quietly, whose idea it was

events.text: The riders of {ct_kingdom} come over the grass at a trot, thousands of them under horsetail banners. From the command tower your generals wait for the order, and the order is yours. The scouts report the enemy drawing up in {ct_scouted}. (Wedge beats Fish Scale, Fish Scale beats Crane Wing, Crane Wing beats Long Snake, Long Snake beats Wedge.)

choices.text: Order Crane Wing: wings wide to fold around them
Order Fish Scale: shields locked, a dense centre
Order Long Snake: a long column that bends and strikes
Order Wedge: one hard point to drive through

events.text: The armies of {ct_kingdom} hold the narrow pass with stone forts on both shoulders. Your generals spread the maps before you: the pass must be taken this year, or the border towns will not see another. The scouts report the enemy drawing up in {ct_scouted}. (Wedge beats Fish Scale, Fish Scale beats Crane Wing, Crane Wing beats Long Snake, Long Snake beats Wedge.)

choices.text: Order Crane Wing: wings wide to fold around them
Order Fish Scale: shields locked, a dense centre
Order Long Snake: a long column that bends and strikes
Order Wedge: one hard point to drive through

events.text: The war fleet of {ct_kingdom} lands on the eastern shore at dawn. Your army reaches the dunes by noon, and the tide is going out. The scouts report the enemy drawing up in {ct_scouted}. (Wedge beats Fish Scale, Fish Scale beats Crane Wing, Crane Wing beats Long Snake, Long Snake beats Wedge.)

choices.text: Order Crane Wing: wings wide to fold around them
Order Fish Scale: shields locked, a dense centre
Order Long Snake: a long column that bends and strikes
Order Wedge: one hard point to drive through

events.text: The elephants and spearmen of {ct_kingdom} come up the river valley in the rain. On the far bank the imperial army waits for your word. The scouts report the enemy drawing up in {ct_scouted}. (Wedge beats Fish Scale, Fish Scale beats Crane Wing, Crane Wing beats Long Snake, Long Snake beats Wedge.)

choices.text: Order Crane Wing: wings wide to fold around them
Order Fish Scale: shields locked, a dense centre
Order Long Snake: a long column that bends and strikes
Order Wedge: one hard point to drive through

events.text: The mountain soldiers of {ct_kingdom} come down from the high plateau with the first snow. Your army stands in the white valley, breath steaming, banners frozen stiff. The scouts report the enemy drawing up in {ct_scouted}. (Wedge beats Fish Scale, Fish Scale beats Crane Wing, Crane Wing beats Long Snake, Long Snake beats Wedge.)

choices.text: Order Crane Wing: wings wide to fold around them
Order Fish Scale: shields locked, a dense centre
Order Long Snake: a long column that bends and strikes
Order Wedge: one hard point to drive through

events.text: A rider reaches the palace with the dust of the front still on him: the army has met {ct_kingdom} in the field, and the generals will not move without the throne's order. The scouts report the enemy drawing up in {ct_scouted}. (Wedge beats Fish Scale, Fish Scale beats Crane Wing, Crane Wing beats Long Snake, Long Snake beats Wedge.)

choices.text: Order Crane Wing: wings wide to fold around them
Order Fish Scale: shields locked, a dense centre
Order Long Snake: a long column that bends and strikes
Order Wedge: one hard point to drive through

events.text: In the war room of the palace the generals argue over the great map until you raise a hand. {ct_kingdom} have gathered their whole strength for one battle. The scouts report the enemy drawing up in {ct_scouted}. (Wedge beats Fish Scale, Fish Scale beats Crane Wing, Crane Wing beats Long Snake, Long Snake beats Wedge.)

choices.text: Order Crane Wing: wings wide to fold around them
Order Fish Scale: shields locked, a dense centre
Order Long Snake: a long column that bends and strikes
Order Wedge: one hard point to drive through

events.text: Beacon after beacon is lit along the border walls: {ct_kingdom} are through the outer line, and the army marches out of the capital to meet them. The scouts report the enemy drawing up in {ct_scouted}. (Wedge beats Fish Scale, Fish Scale beats Crane Wing, Crane Wing beats Long Snake, Long Snake beats Wedge.)

choices.text: Order Crane Wing: wings wide to fold around them
Order Fish Scale: shields locked, a dense centre
Order Long Snake: a long column that bends and strikes
Order Wedge: one hard point to drive through

events.text: The Meridian Gate opens at midnight, and the soldiers who come through it are not coming to bow. Torches move along every corridor of the palace. By morning the throne will have someone else on it.

choices.text: Leave by the water gate in a servant's coat
Walk out to the gate and give up the seal
Gather the last loyal guard and cut a road out

events.text: The enemy's banners are on the hills around the capital, and the city gates will not hold another day. The ministers have already gone. The palace is very quiet, and very large.

choices.text: Leave by the water gate in a servant's coat
Walk out to the gate and give up the seal
Gather the last loyal guard and cut a road out

events.text: The people have stopped waiting for Heaven to change its mind. They come up the great avenue in their thousands with farm tools and torches, and the palace guard opens the gates to them.

choices.text: Leave by the water gate in a servant's coat
Walk out to the gate and give up the seal
Gather the last loyal guard and cut a road out

events.text: The Grand Council met at dawn without you. By noon the Imperial Jade Seal is in another hand, and the guards at your door are polite, and do not move aside. The vote was counted twice. It came out the same both times.

choices.text: Leave by the water gate in a servant's coat
Walk out to the gate and give up the seal
Gather the last loyal guard and cut a road out

events.text: Digging in the overgrown courtyard of the old palace of {ct_ruins}, you strike a stone box. Inside, wrapped in rotten silk, is a small jade seal with a dragon on it. You know, without knowing how, which hand last held it.

choices.text: Keep the seal

effects.log: You keep the seal close. Some nights it is warm in your hand, as if it remembers being used.

choices.text: Sell it to a collector in the capital

effects.log: The collector pays without bargaining and leaves very quickly. (+400 taels)

choices.text: Give it to the old family who still tends the shrine

effects.log: The old keeper of the shrine weeps, and bows to you as if to someone they once served.

events.text: On the anniversary of the fall of {ct_ruins} a few old people still burn incense on the broken steps of the throne hall. One of them looks at you for a long time and says, "You walk the way the last ruler walked."

choices.text: Light incense with them

effects.log: You burn incense on the broken steps. For a moment you remember the hall whole, with lamps lit and a whole court bowing.

choices.text: Ask them how the dynasty fell

effects.log: They tell you everything, the plots and the wars and the last night. You listen like someone hearing their own story.

choices.text: Walk on; the past is past

effects.log: You walk on down the hill. The incense smoke follows you a little way.
